name: Business Document Router
description: Classifies one uploaded business document and routes it to its extraction analyzer.

general-business.description: A general business document that is not an invoice, receipt, or contract.

invoice.description: A bill requesting payment from a customer for supplied goods or services.

receipt.description: Proof of a completed purchase or payment from a merchant.

contract.description: A legal agreement defining terms, obligations, rights, or termination conditions.
